tianxia.talent.space.cut_the_road_behind.why: Run by the Seal plug-in (combat/ext/seal.py): after a teleport of its own a creature may seal the route behind it, and a creature that teleports along that route makes a Cultivation Check or stays put (the Cut the Road Behind You button, the teleport gate). Left to the GM: Only teleports are tracked: using a gate, leaving a pocket space or passing a spatial boundary leaves no trace on the table, so the GM seals those routes by hand. "The same teleport trace" is a teleport that begins within 10 feet of where the sealed one began and ends within 10 feet of where it ended; every creature but you (allies too) makes the Cultivation Check, which is d20 + Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier against your Cultivation Save DC. A creature that fails stays where it was; the ability is spent. Teleports that do not go through a self-teleport (a creature moved by another's ability, an image swap) are not stopped.

tianxia.talent.space.safe_return_mark.why: Run by the Return Mark plug-in (combat/ext/return_mark.py): the mark is a placement on the map and Fold Step and Short Swap get a second button that takes the marker back to it (Safe Return Mark). Left to the GM: The mark is used by Fold Step and Short Swap only: Blink Guard (a Reaction whose destination its own answer picks) and the other Fold Arts named by no button take the mark by hand. The mark ends when another creature ends a move on the marked space; a space that becomes sealed or invalid is the GM's to rule. Short Swap teleports only you to the mark (no swap partner); its CL 10 Bonus Action form is not offered.
